description: Your phone's location, on your own machine, behind a token. An OwnTracks HTTP receiver that stores the trail in a local SQLite/JSON store you own, with named places and distance queries. Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and refuses to start without a token, so there is no unauthenticated path to your location — reads and writes both need it. Retention is capped by default (7 days / 500 points) and `--purge-data` erases the trail on demand. Use when: (1) "where am I?", (2) storing named locations (home, gym, work), (3) querying nearby places by distance, (4) checking location history. Requires: OwnTracks app, Node.js 22+, better-sqlite3. Built for the TinkerClaw fork — github.com/globalcaos/tinkerclaw. See Permissions, Data Flow & Consent.
